records.title: Towards Efficient Training through Critical Periods
records.reason: Critical Learning Periods encompass an important phenomenon involving deep learning, where early epochs play a decisive role in the success of many training recipes, such as data augmentation. Existing works confirm the existence of this phenomenon and provide useful insights. However, the literature lacks efforts to precisely identify when critical periods occur. records.title: ADaFSlide: Adapting Vision-Language Foundation Model for Lifelong Whole Slide Image Analysis
records.reason: Whole Slide Images (WSIs) play an important role in accurate cancer prognosis and diagnosis, as they reveal the structure of organs at the cellular level. However, each WSI can be up to gigapixel resolution (e.g., $10,000 \times 10,000$ pixels), which poses challenges for storage and model training. Moreover, the number of WSIs is increasing rapidly, creating additional challenges for existing models to handle newly added data.
